# uptimekuma_notification_vk (Resource)

VK (VKontakte) notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_vk" "example" {
  name         = "VK Notifications"
  access_token = "vk1.a.YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN"
  peer_id      = "12345"
  is_default   = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_vk" "custom" {
  name             = "VK Notifications (custom API version)"
  access_token     = "vk1.a.YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN"
  peer_id          = "2000000001"
  api_version      = "5.131"
  dont_parse_links = true
  is_default       = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: access_token_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change access_token_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_vk" "write_only" {
  name = "VK with a write-only secret"

  peer_id = "12345"

  access_token_wo         = "vk1.a.YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN"
  access_token_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `peer_id` (String) The recipient. Must be a numeric string: positive for user IDs, negative for community IDs, or 2000000000+chat_id for group chats.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) The VK API user or service access token. Stored in state; use `access_token_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `access_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) VK access token, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `access_token`; requires `access_token_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `access_token_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `access_token` until the next apply with `access_token_wo` set removes it from state.
- `access_token_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `access_token_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `access_token_wo`.
- `api_version` (String) The VK API version to use.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `dont_parse_links` (Boolean) If true, disables link previews in VK notifications.
- `is_default` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
